ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen to guppies if all the ducks died?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows several organisms connected by arrows. I can see guppies near the middle-right, and ducks on the far right. There is an arrow pointing from guppies toward ducks. Reasoning: In this food web, that arrow means ducks eat guppies. If all the ducks died, then one predator of guppies would be removed. With fewer guppies being eaten by ducks, the guppy population would increase.
